HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-11 14:40 PST: OPEN, unsigned. Its prerequisite skilled-cepevorous-naga closed at 14:21 PST (landed d223a42ca76). First plan review (worktree CLI at d223a42ca76, Bedrock, 14:22-14:35 PST) returned BLOCK: 11 blocking and 20 advisory findings. They come down to 4 defects:
(1) The "not-yet-available raise" is in plan_review_engine_route, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py (~:336-346), not __init__.py. Add workflow_ops.py and plan_review_engine_route_output.schema.json to Scope.
(2) The v3 `when:` takes only single references, so the route op must emit a second boolean (e.g. run_agentic), and its output schema must allow it (additionalProperties false). If the raise is removed without a real agentic arm, the review branch's else arm (plan_review_passthrough) gets the precheck's verdict None and raises. The plan must define what the agentic arm emits as the terminal plan_review_verdict.
(3) Registering a new op/schema needs 4 edits: @register_step with input/output contract schemas, CONTRACT_SCHEMAS in src/rebar/schemas/__init__.py, the side-effect import via workflow_ops.py, and _EXPECTED_OPS in tests/unit/test_plan_review_workflow_ops_seam.py. Also: the reviewer prompt's front matter and reviewers/index.json, and the structured-output model via contracts.response_model_for (the runner does not validate against an unregistered schema file).
(4) The read-only tool claim: runner.py grants comment_ticket when not readonly and current_code_root() is None (source=local), and appends req.extra_tools, so withholding comments needs a runner change or a RunRequest field.
Also update tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py, which pins the RuntimeError and zero-call INDETERMINATE. The 4 carry-over advisories from change 3349 are in the previous comment. Next: revise the description (keep it under 8,000 chars), then re-run review-plan. Not claimed and not implemented.
